subject.title: fix(googlechat): media downloads can grow unbounded without a size cap

question: Should the exported Google Chat media helper treat omitted maxBytes as the documented 20 MiB default and fail closed for larger direct downloads?
rationale: The code fix removes an unbounded external-response buffer, but it changes omitted-cap behavior for any direct helper caller that previously relied on uncapped downloads.

options.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
options.body: Land this PR with the documented Google Chat media default and require callers that need larger media to pass an explicit maxBytes.

options.title: Pause for a different helper contract
options.body: Hold the PR if omitted maxBytes should keep a different public meaning, then document and test that contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the documented Google Chat media default and require callers that need larger media to pass an explicit maxBytes.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the alignment commit and already framed the PR as ready for the serialized landing slot after the 20 MiB choice.
